tips: Open with a surprising fact or bold statement to grab attention
Use 'you' and 'we' to speak directly to the reader
Break complex ideas into digestible bullet points or numbered lists
Include at least one real-world example per major point
End each section with a transition sentence to maintain flow
Keep sentences under 25 words on average
Add a clear call-to-action at the end
forbidden: Do not use more than 3 consecutive sentences without a transition

tips: Define all technical terms at first use
Support every claim with a citation or data point
Include code snippets or formulas where relevant
Be precise with measurements, percentages, and dates
forbidden: Avoid first-person singular (use 'we' or passive where needed)

tips: Lead with the most important information (inverted pyramid)
Answer the 5 Ws in the first two paragraphs
Use direct quotes to add authenticity
Remain neutral and objective at all times
